latin: Licet defendi possit quoquomodo creaturam posse creare, rationabilius tamen est credere potentiam creandi creaturae communicari non posse.
translation: Although one might in some fashion defend the claim that a creature can create, it is more reasonable to hold that the power to create cannot be communicated to any creature.
